rawSiteProfile.name: iRunGuns
rawSiteProfile.notes: Custom PHP catalog (irg_products MySQL backend exposed via product.php?departments=X). Categories render the FULL result set server-side into <ul id="content"> and use jPages client-side pagination (perPage:12) — there is NO server-side pagination via URL params (paginationPattern: null, perPage: 100 so crawler never tries next-page). No sitemap, no JSON API. Plain axios GET with rotated desktop UA returns 200 + full HTML for all department URLs — no Playwright needed, no captcha, Sucuri is passive (server: Sucuri/Cloudproxy, x-sucuri-id: 20010). Sort: there is NO <select> for sort or order on category pages — only filter selects (department/category/manufacturer/model/calibre/classes). No URL sort param exists (sortParam: null). BUT natural DOM order on /product.php?departments=X is p.id DESC (newest first). Verified on 2026-04-07 by cross-referencing: GET DOM first product slug on Rifles = "glenfield-model-a-moss-green-308-win-20-barrel-4-rounds" matches the previously-captured POST /product_filter.php endpoint baseline first slug (which had no ORDER BY and therefore used the server-side default = p.id DESC). Same first slug on both paths → same ordering → newest-first proven. Because page 1 is newest-first via natural order, crawlers.watermark.method = navigate-from-watermark. The T1 cursor is the URL slug of the first product on page 1 of each catalog URL (stored in lastWatermarkUrl). GET path was chosen over the embedded POST /product_filter.php endpoint because plain GET already returns every in-stock product — see playbook Mistake 16 (do not follow embedded AJAX/SQL if GET already works). The ~1,760 OOS-only products that only a modified POST-SQL can see are irrelevant for this app (no back-in-stock alerts possible for products never catalogued). Cursor based on p.id was rejected because p.id is server-side only — iRunGuns product URLs are /product_detail.php?p=<slug> where p is a string slug not a numeric id. See playbook Mistake 17. subcategory.php?parent=Firearms is a NAVIGATION/landing page (sub-category links only, 0 product cards) — NOT a product listing. Not in catalogUrls. In-stock counts per dept verified 2026-04-07 via "Showing N result" markers: Rifles=11, Handguns=0, Shotgun=12, Previously_Enjoyed=3, Ammunition=3, Optics=4, Parts_AND_Gear=24, Magazines=22, Clothing=4, Knives=0, Custom_Engraving=0 → 83 total. Production GenericRetailAdapter extracts 87 unique URLs across all 11 dept pages (slight overcount from related/featured blocks is expected and acceptable). Site filters by location_id=2 and pi.quantity>0 in embedded SQL — only in-stock items at that warehouse appear.
